verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions bounce, complaint, or blocklist signals, and offers no deliverability guidance. The only related items are API access to generic 'post-send statistics' for an email and default suppression of unengaged contacts. Neither documents the specific signals or the actionable guidance the story requires, so they count as adjacent features rather than delivery of the story.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades
